summary: Mueller Industries Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a two-for-one forward stock split effected through an amendment to its Restated Certificate of Incorporation. Each holder of record as of June 25, 2026 will receive one additional share after market close on June 30, 2026, with split-adjusted trading expected to begin July 1, 2026. Authorized shares will be proportionately increased. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or management change is involved. This is a routine stock split and not a special situation.
